name: Haruto Matsushima
summary: Product designer with an M.S. in Human-Computer Interaction and experience in product discovery, usability testing, and interaction design. Turns research insights into testable prototypes and implementation-ready designs.

experience.title: Product Designer
bullets: Conducted 20+ usability tests and 5+ user interviews for new-product discovery to identify user needs and validate product hypotheses.
Used AI-assisted coded prototypes to explore concepts, test assumptions, and iterate on product experiences.

experience.title: Product Designer Intern
bullets: Evaluated Figma design system components and proposed improvements aligned with engineering constraints.
Designed pagination concepts and collaborated with PMs and engineers on implementation-ready handoff.
Mapped key user journeys and created low-fidelity flows for a workplace stress-check application, considering regulatory constraints.

experience.title: UX Researcher / Designer Intern
bullets: Analyzed competitor and user experiences to inform content structure and interface design for a talent marketplace contract flow.
Translated research findings into wireframes focused on clarity and confidence during decision-making.

projects.title: ClassCollab
projects.subtitle: Team formation for student projects
bullets: Designed and tested a team formation tool; a landing page MVP recorded a 60% click-through rate, followed by prototype testing with seven graduate students.
Refined onboarding, team previews, and group overviews; the tested prototype received an average System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 82.5.

projects.title: RunBuddy
projects.subtitle: Finding compatible running groups
bullets: Used surveys, interviews, and affinity mapping to identify social and logistical barriers to joining running groups.
Designed a Figma mobile prototype and Framer walkthrough, then iterated through user validation to clarify group fit and joining flows.
